title: DCE/RPC: val_to_str[_ext] -> val_to_str[_ext]_wmem for generated dissectors
description:
Convert to use wmem versions of val_to_str to reduce use of wmem_packet_scope.

Convert the non-generated DCE/RPC dissectors too.
